function.name: submit_report
function.description: Submit an incoming ambulance report to the ER board. Call once you have unit, age, complaint, acuity, ETA, and (for stable patients) the three lobby-screen answers.

complaint.description: Chief complaint, a few words, e.g. 'chest pain'

eta_min.description: Minutes until arrival at the ER

ambulatory.description: Patient can walk. Always false for critical patients.

alert_oriented.description: Patient is alert and oriented. Always false for critical patients.

vitals_stable.description: Vitals are stable. Always false for critical patients.

messages.content: Logging that with the ER now.
I couldn't reach the ER board. Please radio the report in directly.
